text: Siftor-aan nelaaɗo- tuma nde Iisa ibnu Mariyama -yo o his-wi*i: onon banii Israa*iil, pellet komi nelaaɗo e mon goonɗin ɗo ko telli ko adii mi ummaade e Tawreet, mi wonah gadiiɗo e nelaaɓe, mbeɗa weltanira nelaaɗo garoowo caggal am bi*ateeɗo Ahmadu, nde Iisa addaniɓe dallillaaji kollooji goonɗude mbo ɓe mbi*i: ɗum ko mbilewu laaɓngu, min ndewataangu.
